evidenceBoundary: The ProBayes v2 record documents 564 real injection-moulded parts across 47 experimental points, two materials, 334 features and nine data sources, with unique MachineCycleID records and manual quality labels. Exact publisher file names, sizes and MD5 checksums are available. EUDAT B2FIND preserves CC-BY metadata for the earlier v1 release, but the current v2 B2SHARE Rights > License field is blank and the v2 release has a different legacy record, DOI and file manifest. The v1 licence is therefore not assumed to cover v2, which remains non-executable and contributes no accepted measured count until version-specific reuse terms are captured.
